method.deduplication: Deduplication could not be applied. None of the 21 isolates between 2024-03-09 and 2026-07-30 carried a subject identifier, so repeat sampling of one patient or one unit cannot be detected and every isolate is counted. Rates below may be weighted towards whichever subjects were sampled most often. Intended rule: First isolate per subject per organism per period (CLSI M39).
